articles.title: Deep-Sea 'Living Fossil' Filmed Alive for the First Time, Shattering Depth Records
articles.summary: Scientists have captured unprecedented video of a healthy goblin shark in its natural habitat. The sightings near Jarvis Island and the Tonga Trench expand the species' known range and set a new depth record for mackerel sharks at nearly 2,000 meters.

articles.title: Harvard's Silicon Chip Writes DNA with Electricity, Opening Door to Cleaner Synthesis and Data Storage
articles.summary: A new chip synthesizes 64 unique DNA sequences in parallel using water-based enzymes and precise electrical currents. The method avoids hazardous solvents and could scale up for eco-friendly DNA data storage.

articles.title: ESA's Rosalind Franklin Rover to Hunt for Ancient Life in Martian Clay at Oxia Planum
articles.summary: Extensive clay deposits stretching 300 km from Oxia Planum to Mawrth Vallis could preserve biosignatures. The rover, launching in 2028, will drill into these ancient sediments to search for evidence of past life on Mars.
